spans.s:
nf. (-लः-ला or -ली)
A wooden bolt or pin for fastening a door.
mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
A surge or billow.
E.
अर्ज to gain, कलच् affix, ज becomes ग, and the fem. takes both टाप् and ङीप्.

mf. (-लः-ली)
A bolt or bar: see अर्गल.

f. (-का)
A small door pin, a bolt.
E.
as before, कन affix, टाप् for the fem. and इ substituted for अ.

m. (-धः)
A plant, (Cassia fistula.)
E.
ऋ to go, and बध to destroy or prevent, deriv. irr: see आरग्वध.
